==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Right before bed, I researched historical figures who could be described as superheroes. My research led me to the traveling philosopher Apollonius. He then was directly mentioned in my dream.

Within the dream, there were robots that roamed cities in search of people to heal. These robots didn't use medicine or bandages to heal people. Instead they utilized a teal colored mystical energy that they summoned around their hands.

Curious about the robots, I go out of my way to find the tinkerer who invented them. The tinkerer explains that the robots each contain an AI trained on the mystical teachings of Apollonius. I am amazed by the idea that robots could learn magic from the ancient past to help bring superheroics to the modern day.
